summaryJa: 要旨：2022年7月30日、TF CHOSINはコールサイン1.4aに7ライン経由でIMINTを課し、1.4aは同日301822Zにムワファク・サルティ飛行場（OJMS）を出発。301829ZにLREから引き継ぎ、301925ZにSIGINT収集を開始。302028Zに待機地点到着して37SFU3付近でIMINT実施。任務は夜間から翌日にかけて継続され、310239Zに37SFU271付近で未確認航空現象（UAP）を観測。311343Zに基地へ帰還、311409ZにSIGINT収集終了、311458ZにLREへ返却、311519ZにOJMS着陸、311529Zにエンジン停止。フルモーション映像はDGS1が解析。ミッション合計時間20.9時間、IMINT 17.2時間（IMINTタスキング1件実施）、SIGINT 18.7時間（SIGINTタスキング1件実施）、合計タスキング2件実施。ISR活動概要：2028Z以降、指定地点および複数のCOIをスキャン。貨物トラック上の人員、滑走路・周辺のスキャン（NSTR）、“probable technical”や強化構造の観測、複数車両（白/黒の“PUT”、白の“BONGO”等）と約30名の人員を含む車列の追尾・停止、人物がライフルを帯用する行動、車両の荷台に不明物体（可能性として文書上は「砲兵システム」）や搭載式AAAと推定される車両の観測、非稼働のTELAR（ロケット搭載）2両の確認などが記録された。TF CHOSINは1243Z頃にタスクを終了・解除した。
summaryEn: Summary: On 30 Jul 2022 TF CHOSIN tasked callsign 1.4a with IMINT via a 7-line. 1.4a departed Muwaffaq Salti AB (OJMS) at 301822Z, was handed over from the LRE at 301829Z, and began SIGINT collection at 301925Z. The asset arrived on station at 302028Z to perform IMINT over 37SFU3. Operations continued through the night; at 310239Z an unidentified aerial phenomenon (UAP) was observed IVO 37SFU271. The platform returned to base at 311343Z; SIGINT collection terminated at 311409Z; handed back to the LRE at 311458Z; landed at OJMS at 311519Z with engine shutdown at 311529Z. Full-motion video was exploited by DGS1. Mission totals: 20.9 mission hours; IMINT 17.2 hours (1 IMINT tasking prosecuted); SIGINT 18.7 hours (1 SIGINT tasking prosecuted); 2 total taskings prosecuted. ISR activity: From 2028Z onward the platform scanned the specified point and multiple COIs for EEI, observing—per the report—personnel on a cargo truck, runway scans (NSTR), a possible technical, reinforced structure, a convoy including white and black “PUT” vehicles and two white “BONGO” vehicles carrying approximately 30 personnel with multiple stops and interactions, an individual with a rifle slung over the shoulder (area assessed in-report as a possible shooting range), a vehicle with a UI object in the bed (report notes as possible artillery system), a second truck with a possible mounted AAA, follows on a bongo carrying possible barrels, and two TELARs with three rockets loaded that were inactive. TF CHOSIN STA cleared the asset off tasking around 1243Z.
